'File Name: stackslib/src/net/neighbors/mod.rs -> Scope: High. Show a transaction the mempool admits that the block builder or `process_transaction` then rejects (or the reverse), or a fee/size computation where `fee / tx_size` under- or over-counts due to a cast or a size mismatch between the decoded and re-encoded transaction. State whether the divergence lets an underpaying transaction be mined or a valid one be permanently un-mineable. Identity: the admissibility and fee a transaction is judged by in the mempool == the admissibility and fee it is judged by at block inclusion.'
